import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    marks=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=g[0][0] and g[i][j]!=5] # placeholder
    return g

# rule: cells of marker color (non-background) aligned in row/col: recolor background cells strictly between to 3
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=5
    from collections import Counter
    vals=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
    mk=mark[0] if len(mark)==1 else None
    # demo used bg=8, mark=6 -> fill 3. test bg=5, mark=2 -> fill 3
    fill=3
    def do(cells):
        for a in range(len(cells)):
            for b in range(a+1,len(cells)):
                (i1,j1),(i2,j2)=cells[a],cells[b]
                if i1==i2:
                    for j in range(min(j1,j2)+1,max(j1,j2)):
                        if g[i1][j]==bg: g[i1][j]=fill
                if j1==j2:
                    for i in range(min(i1,i2)+1,max(i1,i2)):
                        if g[i][j1]==bg: g[i][j1]=fill
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mk]
    do(pts)
    return g

# verify demo
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
r=transform(inp)
print(r==out)
print([list(x) for x in r])
